items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...when he got talking about Bix or about Fletcher Henderson or Duke or whatever... [INTERVIEWEE] I didn't know that.

ctx.x: -- and a little pompous. And I just take all that out. And then when he got talking about Bix or about Fletcher Henderson or Duke or whatever, that was good, that was great. And I had to get rid of all of the writer stuff.
